subject: reasoning
question: Manoj starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards west. He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, turns right and drives 7 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again (all turns are 90° turns only unless specified)?
solution:
Given:

Manoj starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards west.

He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, turns right and drives 7 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b6138e6ff760eaf0b8af2630de3a51350c04b41bb285dca5a95fe679532972f.png] 

Thus, Manoj should drive 7 km (5 km + 2 km) in the south direction in order to reach point A again.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
